description: This file implements a proxy observer system for managing multiple pipeline frame observers asynchronously in a data processing pipeline. It defines a `TaskObserver` class that manages observer instances, creates asyncio tasks for each, and handles frame event dispatching without blocking the main pipeline.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Data class representing a proxy for managing observer tasks and queues, encapsulating the queue, task, and the observer instance.

classes.name: TaskObserver
classes.description: A proxy observer that manages multiple user-defined observers by queuing frame data and processing it asynchronously, ensuring non-blocking pipeline operation.

methods.name: add_observer(self, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Adds a new observer to the managed list and creates a proxy and task for it if the observer system has already been started.

methods.name: remove_observer(self, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Removes an observer from management, cancels its associated task, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: start(self)
methods.description: Initializes proxies for all managed observers and starts their processing tasks.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with all proxies and observer tasks.

methods.name: on_process_frame(self, data: FrameProcessed)
methods.description: Queues a frame processed event to all managed observers.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Queues a frame pushed event to all managed observers.

methods.name: Proxy _create_proxy(self, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Creates a proxy object for an individual observer, including its queue and processing task.

methods.name: Dict[BaseObserver,Proxy] _create_proxies(self, observers: List[BaseObserver])
methods.description: Creates proxies for all observers in the list.

methods.name: _send_to_proxy(self, data: Any)
methods.description: Dispatches frame event data to all observer queues.

methods.name: _proxy_task_handler(self, queue: asyncio.Queue, observer: BaseObserver)
methods.description: Asynchronous handler for processing frame data from the queue and calling the appropriate observer methods.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, observers: Optional[List[BaseObserver]] = None, task_manager: BaseTaskManager, **kwargs, )

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, *, observers: Optional[List[BaseObserver]] = None, task_manager: BaseTaskManager, **kwargs, )

ctags.name: _proxy_task_handler
ctags.pattern: /^    async def _proxy_task_handler(self, queue: asyncio.Queue, observer: BaseObserver):$/
